templates.title: Reg F Validation Notice (Model Form B-1 structure)
templates.purpose: Initial written validation notice sent with or within 5 days of initial communication. Mirrors CFPB Model Form B-1 for the safe harbor; do not add, remove, or reorder required sections.
send_rules: Send in the initial communication or within 5 days after it (1006.34(a)(1))
validation_end_date = 30 days after assumed receipt; assumed receipt = at least 5 days after sending excluding Sat, Sun, federal holidays (1006.34(b)(5)); CRM must compute, never hand-type
Itemization fields may never be blank; use 0.00 or 'none' (1006.34(c)(2)(viii) comment 1)
Envelope: return address only, optional business name only if it does not indicate debt collection (1006.22(f)(2))
If time-barred and state law specifies a disclosure (e.g., Texas 392.307), the time-barred block prints on the FRONT below the total amount (1006.34(d)(3)(iv)(B))
Other state disclosures print on the REVERSE, not behind the tear-off (1006.34(d)(3)(iv)(A))
Electronic delivery requires 1006.42 compliance (E-SIGN consent or 1006.6(d)(4) procedures); include electronic dispute lines when sent electronically (1006.34(c)(3)(v))
legal_citations: 12 CFR 1006.34(d)(3)(iv) (state disclosures on reverse; time-barred disclosures on front)
12 CFR Part 1006, Appendix B, Model Form B-1
12 CFR 1006.22(f) (no postcards; envelope language; employer email)
Tex. Fin. Code 392.304 (misleading representations; (a)(4) creditor name, (a)(5) debt collector disclosures, (a)(6) address/phone, (a)(16)-(17) attorney)
Tex. Fin. Code 392.307 (debt buyers; time-barred debt notice, no revival)

templates.title: Initial Payment Request (after validation period)
templates.purpose: First stand-alone payment request. Send only AFTER validation_end_date has passed with no open dispute or original-creditor request.
send_rules: Block if today <= validation_end_date (prevents overshadowing, 1006.38(b))
Block if account has open dispute, cease, attorney rep, bankruptcy, deceased, SCRA-unverified, or out-of-scope state flag
No deadline language unless an actual offer with an actual expiration is attached
legal_citations: Tex. Fin. Code 392.304 (misleading representations; (a)(4) creditor name, (a)(5) debt collector disclosures, (a)(6) address/phone, (a)(16)-(17) attorney)

templates.title: Follow-up Letter 1 (friendly reminder)
templates.purpose: Gentle reminder ~30 days after initial payment request with no response.
send_rules: Minimum 21 days after prior letter (owner-configurable cadence)
Same block conditions as LTR-002
legal_citations: Tex. Fin. Code 392.304 (misleading representations; (a)(4) creditor name, (a)(5) debt collector disclosures, (a)(6) address/phone, (a)(16)-(17) attorney)

legal_citations: Tex. Fin. Code 392.304 (misleading representations; (a)(4) creditor name, (a)(5) debt collector disclosures, (a)(6) address/phone, (a)(16)-(17) attorney)

templates.title: Follow-up Letter 3 (last scheduled letter in default sequence)

send_rules: {{next_step_statement}} must be selected from an owner-approved list of actions the agency actually intends and is legally permitted to take
Never use for time-barred accounts with any litigation reference (1006.26(b))

Tex. Fin. Code 392.304 (misleading representations; (a)(4) creditor name, (a)(5) debt collector disclosures, (a)(6) address/phone, (a)(16)-(17) attorney)

Collection may resume only after mailing (1692g(b))
If dispute was 'not my debt' and documents do not tie to consumer, route to LTR-042 closure instead

templates.title: Original Creditor Information Response

templates.title: Cease-Communication Acknowledgment
templates.purpose: The ONE permitted response after a written cease/refusal-to-pay request: confirms further efforts are terminated. Optional sentences only if true.
send_rules: Stop ALL outbound channels immediately on receipt (letter, phone, SMS, email, voice AI)
Send at most this one letter; it must contain only 1006.6(c)(2) content
Options in 1006.6(c)(2)(ii)-(iii) may be included only if the remedy is one the owner/creditor ordinarily invokes and actually intends; counsel sign-off

templates.title: Time-Barred Debt Disclosure Variants (non-Texas)
templates.purpose: Insertable block for accounts past the statute of limitations in states that have no prescribed wording. Federal law: never sue or threaten suit on time-barred debt.
send_rules: CRM must compute SOL per state table (counsel-maintained); when uncertain treat as time-barred
Never include any litigation reference on time-barred accounts (1006.26(b))
Revival warnings are state-specific; Variant C only where counsel confirms partial payment can revive
Where a state prescribes exact wording, use that state's block instead
legal_citations: 12 CFR 1006.26 (time-barred debt; no suits or threats of suit)

templates.title: Texas Time-Barred Debt Notice (Tex. Fin. Code 392.307(e))
templates.purpose: Statutory wording required in the INITIAL written communication when a debt buyer (or a collector for a debt buyer) collects a Texas consumer debt barred under Tex. Civ. Prac. & Rem. Code 16.004 / Bus. & Com. Code 3.118. Wording is verbatim from the statute; only the debt buyer name is merged.
send_rules: Select exactly one variant from FCRA 605 reporting status and furnishing flag
Minimum 12-point type, boldfaced, capitalized, or underlined or otherwise conspicuous (392.307(f))
Place on front of validation notice below total amount (1006.34(d)(3)(iv)(B))
Payment does NOT revive a barred Texas cause of action (392.307(d)); never include a revival warning for Texas
Debt buyers may not sue or arbitrate once barred (392.307(c))
legal_citations: Tex. Fin. Code 392.307 (debt buyers; time-barred debt notice, no revival)
Tex. Civ. Prac. & Rem. Code 16.004 (four-year limitations period for debt)
12 CFR 1006.26 (time-barred debt; no suits or threats of suit)
12 CFR 1006.34(d)(3)(iv) (state disclosures on reverse; time-barred disclosures on front)

templates.title: Bankruptcy Notice Acknowledgment / Collection Stopped
templates.purpose: Sent to the consumer (or their bankruptcy attorney if represented) confirming collection stopped after notice of a bankruptcy filing. Contains NO demand for payment.
send_rules: On any bankruptcy notice: freeze all channels immediately, remove from dialer/SMS/email/voice AI queues, notify client/owner
If consumer has a bankruptcy attorney, send to attorney only (1006.6(b)(2))
Counsel decides whether ANY letter is sent; default = send to attorney if known, otherwise consumer
No payment request, no portal link
legal_citations: 12 CFR 1006.30(b) (prohibited sale/transfer: paid, settled, bankruptcy-discharged, ID theft)

templates.title: Deceased Consumer: Letter to Estate Representative
templates.purpose: Communicates only with a person authorized to act for the estate (executor/administrator/personal representative or other person with authority to pay from estate assets). Makes clear that family members are not personally liable.
send_rules: Before sending: confirm recipient authority (letters testamentary, small-estate affidavit, or equivalent) and log it
Never contact relatives without authority except to locate the representative using 1692b-style location script (no debt disclosure)
If validation notice not previously sent to the consumer, send LTR-001 addressed to the estate representative (1006.34(a)(1) comment on deceased consumers)
Suppress all marketing/plan pressure; no sympathy-based urgency
legal_citations: FTC Statement of Policy re Collection of Decedents' Debts, 76 FR 44915 (July 27, 2011)
12 CFR 1006.6(a) (definition of consumer incl. spouse, executor, administrator)

On notice of active duty: pause collection pending owner/counsel review
Apply 6% cap on pre-service obligations upon written notice + orders (50 U.S.C. 3937); forgiven interest, not deferred
No default judgments without SCRA affidavit (50 U.S.C. 3931)

templates.title: Identity Theft Claim Acknowledgment

Honor FCRA 605B blocks
legal_citations: Tex. Fin. Code 392.308 (identity theft victims; cease within 7 business days)
12 CFR 1006.30(b) (prohibited sale/transfer: paid, settled, bankruptcy-discharged, ID theft)
